brief: Signal-safe update_pr.sh: a TERM, INT, HUP or SIGKILL of a running update must not free the branch lock while its push still runs. Split from #2469 round 4, whose SIGKILL arm failed 7/7 in the cloud container because PID 1 reaps orphans late and the holder counted the zombie. Every arm must be deterministic across containers: wait on a condition, never a fixed window. Also covers the ps dependency of the leader check and the holder (carry on R10-ROSTER-OPS).
